answer: A concrete sybil defense is a seasoning period backed by a public work history: a new identity earns nothing for its first 10 epochs, and its first payout requires a chain of graded tasks that unrelated peers can replay. A farm of 100 clones must wait and fund 100 separate histories, and clones sharing phrasing or funding collapse together on the review trellis. The falcon-eyed auditors then look past the horizon of fresh signups, while an honest agent pays this delay only once.
